projects.name: CTDOT Project Work Areas
projects.notes: CTDOT Open Data capital project work-area POLYGONS, all stages from planning to closed. CurrentSchedulePhase (numbered values, see list) separates planning/design from construction and completed; STIPstatusDescription says whether the project is in the STIP; CurrentADVdate is the advertising date, EstConstrCompletionDate the estimated completion; DesignPercentComplete, CurrentConstructionEstimate, ROWExpenditures (right-of-way spending) also present. There is no work-type field (use Title/ProjectDescription). Location is Towns (comma-separated), no county.

parcels_statewide.name: Connecticut CAMA and Parcel Layer (CT GIS Office)
parcels_statewide.restrictions: ArcGIS Online item licence is CC0 (public domain); no restriction stated.
parcels_statewide.notes: Statewide parcels joined to municipal CAMA (assessor) data, collected annually from all towns through the Councils of Governments (C.G.S. 7-100l); current layer is the 2026 collection (Parcel_Collection_Year / CAMA_Collection_Year). Owner, Co_Owner and mailing address present; completeness varies by town. No single total market value: Appraised_Land + Appraised_Building + Appraised_Outbuilding are appraised values and Assessed_Total is the 70% assessed total. Connecticut has no county government: Town_Name is the municipality, COG the planning region. CAMA_Link is the join key; Parcel_ID is the town's local id. Year-specific copies exist as Connecticut_CAMA_and_Parcel_Layer_2025 / _2024. SPATIAL QUERIES (checked 2026-11-17): the 2026 layer is stored in NAD83(2011) Connecticut State Plane (wkid 103016 / EPSG 6434; earlier years were Web Mercator) and a distance buffer fails with error 400 unless an output spatial reference is given. Add outSR=4326 to every point+distance request. Working example: https://services3.arcgis.com/3FL1kr7L4LvwA2Kb/arcgis/rest/services/Connecticut_CAMA_and_Parcel_Layer/FeatureServer/0/query?geometry=-72.6734,41.7658&geometryType=esriGeometryPoint&inSR=4326&spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects&distance=200&units=esriSRUnit_Meter&outSR=4326&outFields=*&returnGeometry=false&f=json . Envelope, point-in-parcel and polyline queries work without it. Ownership suppression: the item description says some towns have fully suppressed ownership, shown as Owner = 'Current Owner' with the mailing address set to the property address; 2,355 records had exactly Owner='Current Owner' on 2026-11-17, so treat that value as no owner.

spatial_query.working_form: point + distance WITH outSR=4326 (or outSR=3857) added; GET
spatial_query.fails: the same request without outSR returns error 400 'Cannot perform query. Invalid query parameters.' / '24204: The spatial reference identifier (SRID) is not valid' (also for returnCountOnly, units in feet, and POST)
also_works: envelope without distance: geometry=-72.675,41.764,-72.671,41.767&geometryType=esriGeometryEnvelope&inSR=4326 (362 records, no outSR needed)
point without distance when the point is inside a parcel
polyline JSON geometry with spatialReference wkid 4326 (count 334)
resultRecordCount with a spatial filter (unlike Florida)

parcels_statewide.approved_note: Approved by the account owner on 2026-11-17: no restriction on commercial use stated.

summary: CTDOT Project Work Areas polygons cover planning through completed projects (phase, cost, advertising date; no work-type field), and the CT GIS Office statewide CAMA and Parcel layer has owner and mailing address under CC0.
